versions.subject: Detects executable running with non executable extension, used for av bypass
versions.detection:
selection1:
    Image|endswith:
    - '.exe'
    - '.ex_'
    - '.com'
    - '.cmd'
    - '.bat'
    - '.bin'
    - '.pif'
selection2:
    Image|endswith: 'rundll32.exe'
selection2b:
    CommandLine|contains: ".dll"
condition: not selection1 or (selection2 and not selection2b)
versions.spl: NOT (Image IN ("*.exe", "*.ex_", "*.com", "*.cmd", "*.bat", "*.bin", "*.pif")) OR (Image="*rundll32.exe" NOT CommandLine="*.dll*")
